newsitem.title: UK: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United Arab Emirates, Morocco to form a joint company to invest in real estate, trade, agriculture and tourism.
- Saudi's al-Rajhi Banking and Investment Corp posts 222 million riyal net profit in two months.
- A Saudi trade team to visit Jordan on Saturday for talks on trade and industry.
- Tour by Iran's Foreign Minister Velayati to include Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates.
- New petrochemical project in Saudi Arabia at a cost of $70 million as part of offset programme.
- Shareholders of al-Rajhi Banking and Investment Corp demand an increase in paid-in capital, commerce ministry official rejects to discuss the issue.
